_about: Published accuracy over time, for a talk slide contrasting active (glimpse-based) and passive computer vision. Every value was read on 2026-10-01 in the text of the paper that the url and where fields name (usually the cited paper itself), by PDF text extraction or, where marked, from the PDF's vector figure data; leads that were not confirmed this way are in sota-history.md, not here. kind: active = the model chooses where to look; passive = it sees the whole image. series: overall = passive; for ImageNet, trained end to end with data beyond ImageNet-1k (the overall ImageNet frontier is the running maximum over overall and in1k_only); for ADE20K, any system whose decoder and backbone are trained on ADE20K (DINOv3 7B: decoder only), with any pretraining data; in1k_only = passive, trained end to end, ImageNet-1k is the only training data (a teacher trained only on ImageNet-1k is allowed); frozen_ssl = frozen self-supervised backbone with a linear probe; active = sequential glimpses, each chosen after the previous ones; select_once = a policy picks high-resolution patches once from a low-resolution view; borderline = foveated or fixation-based, but not glimpse-limited sensing with a learned policy (see notes). size_class: base = at most about 100M parameters (counted up to 110M; entries between 100M and 110M say so in sota-history.md) in the network that predicts (ImageNet), the backbone (passive ADE20K), or all networks run at test time except an ADE20K decoder (active models); large = above; null = the count is unknown and cannot be bounded. Each passive series holds the records over all model sizes and, collected separately, the records among base-size models (each a point that beat every earlier point of its group; ADE20K: per protocol), plus reference points that sota-history.md names, such as the CanViT paper's own probes. The base-size line of a series is the running maximum of its base points; the all-size line is the running maximum of all its points. date: first public appearance of this number (arXiv version or venue), YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY when only the year is known; year is its year. value: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC-2012) validation top-1 accuracy in %, or ADE20K (SceneParse150) validation mIoU in %; error rates were converted as 100 - error. params_m: parameters in millions of the network(s) that make the prediction at test time (ensembles: the sum; frozen probes: the backbone; passive ADE20K: the backbone; active models: every network run at test time except an ADE20K decoder, with params_detail naming each part and any training-only teacher or critic); taken from the paper, else counted from the official code or computed from the stated architecture (sota-history.md says which for every entry); null when neither is possible. params_total_m (ADE20K): the whole segmentation system including the decoder, when stated or countable, else null. test_px: test image side in px (the crop side, or the shorter side for full-image testing; ADE20K: the single-scale size that multi-scale ratios multiply); null when the paper does not state it or tests over a list of absolute sizes. pretraining: data beyond the benchmark's training set that the weights saw, including initialisation weights and teachers; for ImageNet, none = ImageNet-1k only (labels or not). Active entries also carry glimpse_px (side of a glimpse as fed to the network; null if variable), glimpses (behind the reported value; an average for adaptive stopping) and inference_compute (per image, in the paper's own unit: FLOPs or multiply-adds; null if not reported). protocol (ADE20K only): single-scale, multi-scale, unstated (the paper does not say), linear probe, or linear probe + ms (DINOv2's boosted probe: last 4 layers, 640 px, multi-scale test). Evidence files with the verbatim table lines are kept outside git, in throwaway/history-base/ and throwaway/history-audit/ of the local checkout; sota-history.md lists the source of each point.
